purpose: Auxiliary source-grounded minimal-pair supervision for the conflict sub-head of our method.

labels.supported: mechanically entailed by an exact source sentence or exact passage identity
labels.allowed_use: auxiliary fit-only training or stress testing
labels.forbidden_use: evaluation ground truth or whole-answer correctness

isolation.oof_rule: For each fixed QA held fold, exclude every synthetic pair whose split_component_groups intersects the held groups.

planned_stages: Frozen NLI paired stress test by type
Small conflict head with genuine QA gold as main loss and silver pairwise ranking as auxiliary loss
Group-OOF learned calibration with the incumbent; no unconditional max/OR
One frozen development report only after fit-OOF acceptance
baseline_policy: Formal baseline architecture, parameters, training recipe and readout remain unchanged; all baselines use our shared evaluation geometry only.
